strength.name: Strength
strength.text: +3 kg carry limit and +5% melee damage and knockback per level

fitness.name: Fitness
fitness.text: Stamina comes back 5% faster and window vaults are 3% quicker per level

building.name: Building
building.text: Repairs cost 5% less per level (never below half)

mechanics.name: Mechanics
mechanics.text: Hotwire cars from level 2, quicker with each level

scavenging.name: Scavenging
scavenging.text: Searching takes 5% less time per level

blunt.name: Blunt
blunt.text: With pipes and bats: +6% damage and swings 4% quicker per level

blades.name: Blades
blades.text: With machetes and knives: +6% damage and swings 4% quicker per level

axe.name: Axe
axe.text: With axes: +6% damage and swings 4% quicker per level

firearms.name: Firearms
firearms.text: Gun spread 3% tighter per level (a smaller cone: more shots land)

first_aid.name: First Aid
first_aid.text: Bandages heal 5 health per level; bites bleed 2% less often per level; you heal 10% faster per level

farming.name: Farming
farming.text: Planters give 1 extra vegetable per 3 levels

dampened_gears.name: Dampened Gears
dampened_gears.text: Machines and generators 2 quieter per rank, +1 per 3 points in Ghost

lucky_find.name: Lucky Find
lucky_find.text: 20% chance per rank of one extra item per search

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.text: Stamina comes back 10% faster per rank

thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
thick_skin.text: Zombies hurt you 5% less per rank

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.text: Rank 1: machined suppressor and subsonic rounds at the workbench. Suppressed shots 2 quieter per rank
